capabilities: Highlight sentences above a configurable word threshold
Toggle highlighting on and off via commands
Choose background or underline highlighting with custom colors
Update highlights in real time while typing
extras: README warns the plugin is only tested on Linux desktop; Windows, macOS, and mobile are untested.
motivation: The author built it mainly to keep sentences brief in their own novel.
problem: Obsidian gives no visual feedback about overly long sentences, making it easy to write unclear prose.
summary: Writing aid that highlights sentences exceeding a configurable word-count threshold in both editing and reading modes.
